title: Sancy Tech
descriptionShort: Company website for a Karachi-based DevOps, QA, and web development firm — built front to back as a client project.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: Sancy Tech is a DevOps, QA, and web development company based in Karachi. I built their company website as a full stack client project, covering the frontend pages and backend setup.

title: TNG
descriptionShort: Website for a remote operations support company serving small and mid-size businesses.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: TNG provides remote operations support for small and mid-size businesses. I built their website as a full stack client project.

title: Tyre Shop E-Commerce
descriptionShort: Full stack e-commerce website for a tyre retail business — product listing, cart, checkout, and order management.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: A tyre retail business needed to sell online. I built the storefront front to back during my internship at Naxasware — product listing, product detail, cart, and checkout on the frontend, with REST APIs and MongoDB handling products and orders on the backend.

sections.heading: Features
content: Product listing and product detail pages with dynamic routing
REST APIs for product, cart, and order management

sections.heading: Tech Stack
content: Frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui

title: Aquarise Interflow
descriptionShort: Multi-vendor water delivery platform with authentication, product management — frontend built by me.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: Aquarise Interflow is my Final Year Project (FYP), a web platform where multiple vendors can sell drinking water. Customers can explore vendor stores, compare ratings, and place orders. My part was the frontend.

sections.heading: Features
content: Vendors can add, edit, and delete products

title: Weather Forecast App
descriptionShort: Weather forecast app using OpenWeatherMap API with real-time city search.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: A React-based weather application where users can search by city and see current temperature, humidity, and conditions using OpenWeatherMap API.

sections.heading: Features
content: Dynamic background updates based on weather

title: Authentication Flow (React)
descriptionShort: A complete authentication system with login, signup, OTP-based password reset, and routes.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: This project demonstrates a full authentication flow built with React, covering login, signup, password recovery, and secure redirection. It provides a seamless user experience with email-based OTP verification for resetting passwords.

sections.heading: Features
content: User Login and Signup with form validation
Forgot Password with email-based OTP verification
Reset Password with OTP + new password

title: Mock Website for Client
descriptionShort: Responsive website section designed as a client mock-up with smooth UI and layout.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: Created a responsive website layout for a mock client to practice UI/UX design principles. The website features service sections, navigation, and responsive grid layouts.

title: Todo App
descriptionShort: Minimal and responsive task manager built with React and LocalStorage.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: A simple Todo App built using React.js. It allows users to add, delete, and mark tasks as completed while storing data in local storage.
